title: Standardized Immunohistochemical Staining for Human Protein Atlas
author: Anna Martinez Casals
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yj8furw

steps.title: Dry and Bake Paraffin Sections
steps.instruction: Dry paraffin sections at room temperature overnight, then bake them at 50 °C for 12 hours (from 12:00:00 to 24:00:00).

steps.title: Xylene Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate slides in xylene. The text specifies durations of 00:05:00, 00:05:00, and 00:01:00.

steps.title: Ethanol and H2O2 Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate slides in 96% ethanol and 30% H2O2 (1:100) for 00:05:00.

steps.title: Antigen Retrieval
steps.instruction: Perform heat-induced epitope retrieval using a pressure boiler (Decloaking chamber model DC2008INTL).

substeps.instruction: Heat slides immersed in retrieval buffer for 00:04:00 at 125 °C.
Allow slides to cool down to 90 °C within the pressure boiler (Total time 00:45:00).

steps.title: Blocking and Primary Antibody Staining
steps.instruction: Transfer slides to the Autostainer 480 (ThermoFisher Scientific, cat# A80500007); all subsequent incubations are performed at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Rinse slides in wash buffer.
Incubate slides with Ultra V Block for 00:05:00.
Rinse slides in wash buffer.
Incubate slides with primary antibody, diluted in antibody Diluent OP, for 00:30:00.
Rinse slides in wash buffer.

steps.title: HRP and DAB Detection
steps.instruction: Apply the detection system and chromogen using the Autostainer 480.

substeps.instruction: Incubate slides with labeled HRP polymer for 00:30:00.
Rinse slides in wash buffer.
Incubate slides with DAB solution for 00:05:00.
Rinse slides in distilled water.

steps.title: Post-Staining Wash and Dehydration
steps.instruction: Transfer slides to the Autostainer XL (Leica biosystems, cat# Leica ST5010 Autostainer XL) for final processing.

substeps.instruction: Rinse slides in lithium carbonate water (diluted 1:5 from saturated solution) for 00:01:00.
Rinse slides in tap water for 00:05:00.
Incubate slides in 80% ethanol for 00:03:00.

steps.title: Mounting
steps.instruction: Mount a coverslip on each slide using Pertex as the mounting media.

steps.title: Final Dehydration and Clearing
steps.instruction: Perform a series of ethanol and clearing agent incubations.

substeps.instruction: Incubate slides in absolute ethanol for 00:03:00 (repeated twice).
Incubate slides in 96% ethanol for 03:00:00.
Incubate slides in 80% ethanol for 00:03:00.
Incubate slides in distilled water (or until antigen retrieval step).
Incubate slides in 96% ethanol for 00:03:00 (repeated twice).
Incubate slides in 99% ethanol for 00:03:00 (repeated three times).
Incubate slides in NeoClear for 00:03:00 (repeated twice).
